board: Anima-Engine Map v2 - G-REF visual reference board
licence_rule: Only CC0 or public domain (NASA, USGS, NOAA and other US federal works; Commons files tagged PD or CC0; Poly Haven; ambientCG). Excluded: CC BY, CC BY-SA, Unsplash, Pexels, anything mixed or unclear.
method: Candidates from Commons search (structured-data licence filters), Poly Haven public API and NASA EO. Every source page was opened and its licence box read; preview sizes come from HTTP HEAD. No image file was downloaded.
